chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Huzayfa ibn ibn Mansur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, made the Hajj obligatory upon the people of Al-Jeddah every year.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْجِدَةِ: The people of Al-Jeddah (a specific community or place)

ai.seo_question: Who is required to perform Hajj every year according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) stating that Allah made Hajj obligatory upon 'Ahl al-Jiddah' (the wealthy/capable) every year. While the majority of Shia scholars interpret 'Jiddah' as referring to those with sufficient means and freedom from debt, this narration is often cited in discussions regarding the frequency of Hajj (once vs. annually) for the specifically capable, distinguishing it from the general obligation of 'Qudrah'.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Huzayfa Bin Mansour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Necessitated the Hajj upon the people of Al-Jeddah during every year’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has made al-Hajj obligatory on people of Jaddah every year.”’
